comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — The cookie-consent bar on sportsdle.com ("We value your privacy", Accept All / Reject All / Cookie Settings) is an inline-styled fixed bottom overlay that survived the full AdGuard baseline, so a domain-scoped hiding rule was added for it and verified in the proxy experiment (banner gone, page intact). The rule goes to AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt at the end of the "Cookies - Specific basic" region, before line 17005. ## Rule `sportsdle.com##div[style*="position: fixed"][style*="z-index: 9999"]` ## Policy rationale The report is a cookie notice, which the AdGuard filter policy assigns to the AdGuard Cookie Notices (Annoyances) filter; the policy's Cookie Notices section states hiding or blocking the corresponding script is usually sufficient. No run-instruction rule closes this report:⁠ it is not a paywall, not an anti-adblock wall, not self-promotion, and not a scam/phishing page. The fix is a domain-scoped element-hiding rule; no gate, scroll lock or consent-dependent feature was observed on the page. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/a341349a321a1c55a33686836cf2e9963859bedd/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt) Under the heading `! SECTION: Cookies - Specific basic`, before [line 17005](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/a341349a321a1c55a33686836cf2e9963859bedd/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt#L17005). ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |
## Artifacts https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/45727360816 Automated analysis against filters at `a341349`. Posted by a filters agent; a maintainer reviews before anything is merged.

The filter policy leaves this report to a maintainer

## Reproduced symptom

Reproduced:⁠ with filtering, player.antyradio.pl keeps its #⁠player, podcast column and "POSŁUCHAJ RÓWNIEŻ" sections stuck on "Trwa ładowanie ..." spinners; unfiltered, the page shows the Agora/OneTrust consent dialog and, once accepted, loads that content with a pre-roll ad. Since the ad-block detector script never appears in the captured requests (antiAdblockDetected=false, no wall in the DOM) and the level OneTrust allowlist rule did not restore the consent dialog, this needs a maintainer rather than a new rule from this run.

## Still visible after the rule

- #⁠player / main radio player at top — The main player area is a large black panel containing only a small centered loading spinner; no player controls, track info or playable audio UI appear.
- Podcast column left of the Kanały muzyczne grid — The left podcast column remains blank with a loading spinner; no podcast cards or links are rendered.
- POSŁUCHAJ RÓWNIEŻ section — Below the 'POSŁUCHAJ RÓWNIEŻ' heading the section is a large blank area with a centered loading spinner; the station list/content is absent.
- POSŁUCHAJ RÓWNIEŻ stations section, between the section heading and the footer — The stations section is an empty reserved loading area with a centered animated spinner placeholder and no station tiles or playable station content. This repeats the reporter-defined endless loading / withheld-content symptom in the 'POSŁUCHAJ RÓWNIEŻ' section.
- Top #⁠player panel, full-width black area directly under the main navigation — Centered loading spinner in a large otherwise empty player area; no track metadata, player controls, or audio content appears, matching the reporter-described endless 'Trwa ładowanie ...' player state.
- and 1 more of the same, in the run artifacts

## Policy rationale

Run instruction, Filter policy:⁠ "Anti-adblock walls:⁠ write a rule only once the page's requests the agent captured show the detector script; without it, hand the report to a maintainer." The issue is filed as an 'Anti Adblock Script' report, and the captured requests for player.antyradio.pl show no detector script (experiments report antiAdblockDetected=false; no wall, popup or ad-block message exists in the DOM), so no anti-adblock rule may be written by this run. Run instruction:⁠ "A notice that the ad blocker breaks the site's consent banner is a cookie-consent problem, not an anti-adblock wall" - what the page shows is a consent/ad-gated player that never leaves its loading placeholder, not a wall, so the resolution touches the shared consent/ad framework and is a maintainer decision. Run instruction:⁠ "Do not block a shared video-player or ad-framework SDK ... that collateral risk is human-review territory" - the gate on this page is driven by the site's ad module on gfx-player.radiozet.pl (Yieldbird/GPT) plus the OneTrust consent SDK, both shared by the whole Eurozet player family.

<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"89da144076ee421ced5d3a39c0271a4421e1cbad2c6bf811ea2fe1a092fae503"} -->
Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — thegirlinspired.com replaces its article with a Raptive ad-block-recovery wall ("An ad blocker is preventing this page from loading", help address thegirlinspired@⁠error-report.com); the page's inline Raptive scripts set __adblocker then load https:⁠//html-load.com/bundle.js, whose decoded strings point at error-report.com. The CLI baseline never shows the wall because it redirects ads.adthrive.com/abd/abd.js to a no-op ($redirect is unsupported in the reporter's Safari-based AdGuard Mini), so the rule could not be verified — apply_rule phase A was refused with HTTP 403. Candidate for review:⁠ extend the existing ||html-load.com^ family in BaseFilter/sections/specific.txt with ||html-load.com^$script,domain=thegirlinspired.com; alternatively add the domain to the Raptive scriptlet group on lines 106-107 of that file.

## Candidate for review

`||html-load.com^$script,domain=thegirlinspired.com`

BaseFilter/sections/specific.txt

Not verified: apply_rule could not judge the candidate:⁠ phase A navigation failed twice with 'Phase A navigation failed (http_blocked):⁠ main document returned HTTP 403', and the host instructed to finish analysis-only. Beyond that refusal, the reported wall is product-specific:⁠ the CLI baseline applies ||ads.adthrive.com/abd/abd.js$xmlhttprequest,redirect=noopjs, so the page's __adblocker cookie is never set and the html-load.com bundle is never requested in either phase; full-page vision over the loaded baseline page returned reporterSymptomPresence 'absent' (instanceCount 0). $redirect is not supported by SafariConverterLib, the execution model of the reporter's AdGuard Mini for Mac, which is why the wall appears for them but not in this environment.

## Missing information

- Safari "Script/scriptlet rules" limitation section not served by lookup_rule_guidance: The linked AdGuard filter-syntax document lists a heading "#⁠#⁠#⁠#⁠ Script/scriptlet rules" under "#⁠#⁠#⁠#⁠ SafariConverterLib {#⁠safari-converter-lib}", but three lookup_rule_guidance calls (topics compatibility and scriptlet, queries naming Safari/SafariConverterLib/scriptlets) never returned that section — they returned the basic-rules and HTML-filtering limitation sections instead. For this report the answer matters:⁠ the reporter uses AdGuard Mini for Mac (Safari content blocker, where the doc states $redirect is NOT supported), and I need to know whether scriptlet (#⁠%#⁠//scriptlet) rules run in that product before choosing between the existing Raptive scriptlet group (BaseFilter/sections/specific.txt lines 106-107) and a plain network rule as the fix.

## Artifacts

https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/45732310103

<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"edf1ad5dd48adafbeb23752492672a98881655770ac5083887a1e9bc7b309244"} -->
Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — On kofunkan.pref.kumamoto.jp the Social Media filter hides the AddToAny share buttons and leaves the pale-gray "この記事をシェアする" band as an empty leftover strip. The repository already has a shared 88-domain `.c-share` rule in SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt (line 11782), and adding this domain fixes the leftover in the browser experiment, but the bound vision review refused to confirm it, so the rule goes to a maintainer for review.

## Candidate for review

`kofunkan.pref.kumamoto.jp##.c-share`

SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt

Not verified: apply_rule returned environmentExperiment=inconclusive with no failedCandidateChecks, but the bound vision review rejected the candidate as symptom 'not_resolved' with ad layout residue present. That rejection is contradicted by the experiment's own structure facts (`.c-share` visible 48px in phase B, hidden 0px in phase C, document height 3537→3489) and by independent reads of the same phase-C artifacts, which show no 'この記事をシェアする' text and identify the remaining pale band as the site's own 前の記事へ/次の記事へ navigation row. domChecks measured the leftover space as the transparent wrapper's 30px/20px padding with nothing painting a background. The rule appears to fix the reported leftover share strip but could not be confirmed by the bound visual review.

## Still visible after the rule

- 記事本文の展示写真の下、前の記事へ／次の記事へナビゲーションの上 — 展示写真の直後から前後記事ナビの間に、共有ラベルや共有ボタンが見当たらない淡いグレーの空帯が残っている。候補後も共有ウィジェットの内容は表示されず、空白のみが残っている。
- Full-width pale-gray band directly below the mascot photo and above the 前の記事へ / 次の記事へ navigation — The reserved social-share band is present but appears empty; no social-share buttons or usable share controls are visible in it.

## Executor and version

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/45737622040

Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — higo-canvas.com article pages carry an AddToAny social share bar (div.c-share, label 「この記事をシェアする」) that the reporter annotated and filed as a Social Widget; the same `.c-share` selector is already hidden by the shared 88-domain rule at SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt:⁠11782, so the fix is to add higo-canvas.com to that rule (higo-canvas.com first in the domain list). The candidate `higo-canvas.com##.c-share` verified in the before/after experiment:⁠ widget hidden, page integrity intact, no leftover residue. ## Rule `higo-canvas.com##.c-share` ## Policy rationale The repository's policy closes paywall reports and hands anti-adblock walls without a captured detector script to a maintainer; neither applies here — the target is an AddToAny social share widget, which the AdGuard Social filter exists to block. The policy excludes widgets that are part of the site's functionality or content (comments, embedded posts, polls, login widgets) and links to the site's social pages; a 「この記事をシェアする」 share bar is none of these and the same `.c-share` widget is already filtered on 88 other domains. No self-promotion, paywall, or anti-adblock rule of the run instruction blocks this fix, so rule generation is allowed. ## Place in the list [SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/951ebfa7d4cbb4c44a7349ad3bfeb50e600a398e/SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt) By adding the domain to the existing rule on [line 11782](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/951ebfa7d4cbb4c44a7349ad3bfeb50e600a398e/SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt#L11782). ## Screenshots

Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — The Yahoo!フリマ topics article still showed its social share widget — the "この記事をシェアする" block above the article navigation and the share icon row in the header — because the Social filter only hides the individual Facebook/X/LINE share links, leaving the wrapper and label behind; the new rule paypayfleamarket.yahoo.co.jp#⁠#⁠.SocialButton in SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt hides the whole widget and was verified in the browser experiment (symptom resolved, page intact, no residue). ## Rule `paypayfleamarket.yahoo.co.jp##.SocialButton` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale The run instruction's filter policy only closes paywalls and hands anti-adblock walls without a captured detector script to a maintainer; a social share widget is neither, so rule generation is allowed. The target is a social widget in the site's own served HTML and the fix is a cosmetic rule for the Social filter, which the repository keeps in SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt. ## Place in the list [SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/4118494c794f59175814ed53f1ddf43a3960b9e4/SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt) Under the heading `! NOTE: Specific rules`, before [line 10723](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/4118494c794f59175814ed53f1ddf43a3960b9e4/SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt#L10723). ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |

comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — On sanyu.co.jp the "この記事をシェアする" share strip stays visible as an empty labeled bar because the Social Media filter already hides its Facebook/Twitter/LINE buttons. Extending the existing shared rule `…##.c-share` in SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt (line 11782) with sanyu.co.jp hides the whole strip, and the validated experiment confirmed the symptom is gone with page integrity intact. ## Rule `sanyu.co.jp##.c-share` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale The run instruction's close/hand-off rules cover paywalls, anti-adblock walls (no detector request was captured here) and self-promotion; none applies:⁠ the captured requests are social-plugin loaders, and the target is a social share widget. The element falls under the AdGuard Social Media filter's stated purpose (blocking third-party social share buttons/widgets on third-party sites). AdGuard filter policy's social-media limitations (comments, embedded posts, polls, social login, links to the site's own social pages) do not apply — this is a plain share strip. Maintainer rule on shared rules:⁠ extend the existing shared rule instead of writing a new one; the .c-share rule is a class-name shared rule, not a group kept for one project. ## Place in the list [SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/4c39d682c0e34dbac56cc09181180ca6a4b43f24/SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt) By adding the domain to the existing rule on [line 11782](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/4c39d682c0e34dbac56cc09181180ca6a4b43f24/SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt#L11782). ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |
## Artifacts https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/45737309102 Automated analysis against filters at `4c39d68`. Posted by a filters agent; a maintainer reviews before anything is merged.

comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — On www⁠.fit.ac.jp the AdGuard Social filter's generic rules hide the LINE/X/Facebook share links but leave the "この記事をシェアする" block as an empty gap, exactly the area the reporter circled; the candidate fit.ac.jp#⁠#⁠.c-research-sns hides that leftover container and was verified to clear the empty gap with page integrity intact. ## Rule `fit.ac.jp##.c-research-sns` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale The run instruction's filter policy closes paywalls and anti-adblock reports without a captured detector script; this report is neither — the page loads fully and no wall, gate or consent message is involved. The filter policy for social media filters states that third-party Like/Share widgets are blocked by the Social filter, which the generic rules in AdGuard Social filter already do here; hiding the empty container that blocking leaves behind is in scope for the Social filter. The advertiser-facing policy clauses (self-promotion, paywalls, anti-adblock) do not apply, so the report is open to rule generation. ## Place in the list [SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/4c39d682c0e34dbac56cc09181180ca6a4b43f24/SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt) Under the heading `! NOTE: Specific rules`, before [line 14141](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/4c39d682c0e34dbac56cc09181180ca6a4b43f24/SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt#L14141). ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |
## Artifacts https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/45737419494 Automated analysis against filters at `4c39d68`. Posted by a filters agent; a maintainer reviews before anything is merged.
